name: When should I consider professional handrail repair instead of a DIY fix?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional handrail repair instead of a DIY fix?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional repair when handrails are structurally unstable, show signs of extensive rot or rust, or if you're unsure about the extent of the damage. Professional contractors ensure repairs meet safety codes and provide lasting solutions. DIY fixes are suitable for minor cosmetic issues or simple tightening, but anything affecting stability, especially on stairs or elevated areas, warrants expert attention to prevent accidents.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional repair is essential for structural instability, extensive damage, or when safety is a concern. DIY is only for minor cosmetic fixes.
